comparability.reason: Both runs used mcp-scorecard@0.5.10; score deltas are reported only when the npm package version is unchanged.

limitations: The score measures agent-readiness metadata, schemas, discovery and declared safety cues — not correctness or security.
Unreachable means the package could not be graded fairly; it is not a low score.
A score movement is directional evidence only when both runs use the same engine version and the package version is unchanged.
